name: Dubai
tagline: From the world's tallest tower to a one-dirham creek crossing
hero_description: Dubai runs on superlatives — the 828 m Burj Khalifa, a mall with over a thousand stores and its own aquarium, palm-shaped islands you can see from space. But the city's best trick is contrast: an hour from the observation decks you're dune-bashing in the desert, and one dirham buys a wooden abra ride across the creek to gold and spice souks that predate it all.
best_time_to_visit: November to April — mild, outdoor-friendly weather in the 20s to low 30s °C; summer regularly tops 40°C, when Dubai retreats happily indoors.

top_attractions.name: Burj Khalifa — At the Top
top_attractions.description: The world's tallest building at 828 m — observation decks on levels 124–125 (and a lounge at 148) look down on the Dubai Fountain, which performs at its feet every evening.

top_attractions.name: Desert safari
top_attractions.description: 4x4 dune-bashing on the golden dunes outside the city, a camel ride at sunset, then BBQ dinner and live shows at a Bedouin-style camp under the stars.

top_attractions.name: Dubai Mall
top_attractions.description: One of the world's largest malls — 1,200-plus stores alongside a walk-through aquarium tunnel and an Olympic-size ice rink, at the base of the Burj Khalifa.

top_attractions.name: Old Dubai & the Creek souks
top_attractions.description: Cross Dubai Creek by wooden abra for about one dirham to Deira's Gold Souk and Spice Souk — the trading Dubai that existed long before the skyline.

top_attractions.name: Palm Jumeirah
top_attractions.description: The famous man-made palm island — ride the monorail up its spine to the crown, with skyline-and-sea views from The View at The Palm.

top_attractions.name: Dubai Frame & Museum of the Future
top_attractions.description: Two of the city's newest icons: a 150 m golden picture-frame with old Dubai on one side and new on the other, and the torus-shaped Museum of the Future on Sheikh Zayed Road.

activities: Sunset slot at the Burj Khalifa observation decks, then the fountain show
Evening desert safari with dune bashing and a BBQ camp dinner
Abra crossing and a wander through the Gold and Spice Souks
Dinner cruise through the Dubai Marina skyscraper canyon
Beach afternoon at JBR or Kite Beach with the skyline behind
Seasonal visits to Global Village and Miracle Garden (roughly Nov–Apr)
